draft.subject: New Grad Inquiry — Embedded Software Engineer (Sunrise, FL) | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas, a recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (May 2026). I wanted to reach out regarding Ford's Embedded Software Engineer opening in Sunrise, FL (Job ID 66197). My background spans bare-metal C/C++, FreeRTOS, UART/I2C/SPI hardware integration, and embedded Linux — which maps directly to what the role requires.

Most relevant to this position, I built STM32 Cortex-M4 firmware in bare-metal C — timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver without HAL abstraction — achieving a 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM footprint at a deterministic 1 Hz rate. I have also implemented FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination linking Jetson-based YOLO detection to STM32 servo control over UART, and resolved 11 integration failures in my MS capstone to achieve 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) using Arduino C++ IK and I2C-mux-driven ToF sensors.

As Ford's university recruiter, I imagine you work with new engineering grad pipelines directly, so I'm hoping this is the right channel for this role. I did notice the posting contains two different statements on visa sponsorship — one indicating it is not supported, another stating it is available. I'm on F-1 OPT and would appreciate any clarification on that before submitting a formal application.

I'd be glad to connect and learn more about the team. I am attaching my resume for your reference.
draft.hook_used: Troy is University Recruiter — referenced his new-grad pipeline mandate as reason for outreach
